meta.title: Vietnam Trip Travel Guide | 8 Days Itinerary & Budget | Phú Quốc , Hanoi, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh
meta.description:
I discuss about Vietnam budget from India and  Vietnam 8 Days Itinerary

Planning a trip to Vietnam? This complete travel guide covers everything you need to know to build the perfect itinerary from start to finish.

In this video, I walk you through the entire planning process using map visualizations to show you exactly how to map out your route. We cover everything from booking flights and navigating the e-visa process to finding the best hotels, choosing top experiences, and identifying the absolute best times to visit. If you want to plan an efficient, seamless trip while unlocking the best ways to save money along the way, this step-by-step guide is for you.

📌 Helpful Links & Resources:

Official E-Visa Portal: https://evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn

💬 What's Covered in This Video:

How to navigate the official e-visa process smoothly

Strategies for finding flights and choosing hotels

A complete route walkthrough using visual maps

Must-visit places and unforgettable experiences across Vietnam

The best seasons to visit different regions

Smart insider tips to save money and maximize efficiency

If you found this guide helpful, please hit the Like button and Subscribe for more in-depth travel guides and visual itineraries. Have a specific question about your upcoming trip? Drop it in the comments below and I'll see you there!
